name: nuScenes
description: nuScenes is the first large-scale dataset to provide data from the entire sensor suite of an autonomous vehicle (6 cameras, 1 LIDAR, 5 RADAR, GPS, IMU)

value.name: human.pedestrian.adult
value.description: Adult subcategory.

value.name: human.pedestrian.child
value.description: Child subcategory.

value.name: human.pedestrian.wheelchair
value.description: Wheelchairs. If a person is in the wheelchair, include in the annotation.

value.name: human.pedestrian.stroller
value.description: Strollers. If a person is in the stroller, include in the annotation.

value.name: human.pedestrian.personal_mobility
value.description: A small electric or self-propelled vehicle, e.g. skateboard, segway, or scooters, on which the person typically travels in a upright position. Driver and (if applicable) rider should be included in the bounding box along with the vehicle.

value.name: human.pedestrian.police_officer
value.description: Police officer.

value.name: human.pedestrian.construction_worker
value.description: Construction worker

value.name: animal
value.description: All animals, e.g. cats, rats, dogs, deer, birds.

value.name: vehicle.car
value.description: Vehicle designed primarily for personal use, e.g. sedans, hatch-backs, wagons, vans, mini-vans, SUVs and jeeps. If the vehicle is designed to carry more than 10 people use vehicle.bus. If it is primarily designed to haul cargo use vehicle.truck.

value.name: vehicle.motorcycle
value.description: Gasoline or electric powered 2-wheeled vehicle designed to move rapidly (at the speed of standard cars) on the road surface. This category includes all motorcycles, vespas and scooters.

value.name: vehicle.bicycle
value.description: Human or electric powered 2-wheeled vehicle designed to travel at lower speeds either on road surface, sidewalks or bike paths.

value.name: vehicle.bus.bendy
value.description: Bendy bus subcategory. Annotate each section of the bendy bus individually.

value.name: vehicle.bus.rigid
value.description: Rigid bus subcategory.

value.name: vehicle.truck
value.description: Vehicles primarily designed to haul cargo including pick-ups, lorrys, trucks and semi-tractors. Trailers hauled after a semi-tractor should be labeled as vehicle.trailer

value.name: vehicle.construction
value.description: Vehicles primarily designed for construction. Typically very slow moving or stationary. Cranes and extremities of construction vehicles are only included in annotations if they interfere with traffic. Trucks used to haul rocks or building materials are considered vehicle.truck rather than construction vehicles.

value.name: vehicle.emergency.ambulance
value.description: All types of ambulances.

value.name: vehicle.emergency.police
value.description: All types of police vehicles including police bicycles and motorcycles.

value.name: vehicle.trailer
value.description: Any vehicle trailer, both for trucks, cars and bikes.

value.name: movable_object.barrier
value.description: Temporary road barrier placed in the scene in order to redirect traffic. Commonly used at construction sites. This includes concrete barrier, metal barrier and water barrier. No fences.

value.name: movable_object.trafficcone
value.description: All types of traffic cone.

value.name: movable_object.pushable_pullable
value.description: Objects that a pedestrian may push or pull. For example dolleys, wheel barrows, garbage-bins, or shopping carts.

value.name: movable_object.debris
value.description: Movable object that is left on the driveable surface that is too large to be driven over safely, e.g tree branch, full trash bag etc.

value.name: static_object.bicycle_rack
value.description: Area or device intended to park or secure the bicycles in a row. It includes all the bikes parked in it and any empty slots that are intended for parking bikes.

value.name: vehicle.moving
value.description: Vehicle is moving.

value.name: vehicle.stopped
value.description: Vehicle, with a driver/rider in/on it, is currently stationary but has an intent to move.

value.name: vehicle.parked
value.description: Vehicle is stationary (usually for longer duration) with no immediate intent to move.

value.name: cycle.with_rider
value.description: There is a rider on the bicycle or motorcycle.

value.name: cycle.without_rider
value.description: There is NO rider on the bicycle or motorcycle.

value.name: pedestrian.sitting_lying_down
value.description: The human is sitting or lying down.

value.name: pedestrian.standing
value.description: The human is standing.

value.name: pedestrian.moving
value.description: The human is moving.
